question: Should primary-DM recovery become a supported Telegram product feature with a maintained enablement and storage/ownership contract, or should this experimental implementation stay out of the repository until that direction exists?
rationale: The branch is intentionally not enabled or deployed, yet it adds public SDK surface and delivery semantics that cannot be safely finalized without deciding who owns activation, persistence, freshness, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Pause pending Telegram feature ownership
options.body: Keep the PR unmerged until an owner approves a supported activation and lifecycle design for real Telegram deployments.

options.title: Narrow to shared dispatcher repair
options.body: Retain only any independently justified generic delivery-outcome repair and remove Telegram-specific recovery APIs until a Telegram owner design is approved.

recommendation.title: Pause pending Telegram feature ownership
recommendation.body: Keep the PR unmerged until an owner approves a supported activation and lifecycle design for real Telegram deployments.
